name: Keto Cabbage "Hash Browns" & Eggs with Tomato-Chive Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ medium head napa cabbage
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; quarter the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to a large bowl.
Peel shallots and slice in half lengthwise, then thinly slice into half rings. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add eggs and spices to the bowl with the cabbage and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add half cabbage mixture to the skillet, pressing down with a spatula to flatten. Then, using the spatula, divide the mixture into 6 hash browns. Cook until tender and golden, about 3 minutes per side; transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add remaining cabbage mixture to the skillet and cook using the same method, to make another 6 hash browns.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes and chop chives into small pieces. Transfer both to a small bowl with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wipe out the skillet and return to medium heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches, gently crack the eggs into the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide hash browns, eggs, and tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!
